## Description

Handbook Sync Audit — verifies that generated handbooks stay aligned with their sources across three axes: (1) content reflection against the ai-workspace upstream (docs/designs, docs/adr), (2) structural linkage within and between handbook repositories, and (3) section-level language parity (ko/en/ja/es) that pinpoints exactly which sections a translation is missing. Responds to "audit handbook", "handbook parity check", "handbook sync audit", "textbook drift check".
